Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that no official citation had been provided to verify Brooklyn College’s parent organization, even though the immediately prior WebSurfer step (step 12) surfaced official Brooklyn College pages on the brooklyn.cuny.edu domain explicitly indicating it is a member unit of the City University of New York (CUNY). This oversight ignored available authoritative evidence and led to unnecessary repetition.
